title: Old MacDonald Had a Farm 🎶 #shorts #nurseryrhymes
description:
Sing along with us! 🎶

Lyrics :
Old MacDonald had a farm,
E-i-e-i-o! And
on his farm he had a cow,
E-i-e-i-o! With a
moo moo here, and a moo moo there,
here a moo, there a moo, everywhere a moo moo.
Old MacDonald had a farm,
E-i-e-i-o!

Old MacDonald had a farm,
E-i-e-i-o! And
on his farm he had a duck,
E-i-e-i-o! With a
quack quack here, and a quack quack there,
here a quack, there a quack, everywhere a quack quack.
Old MacDonald had a farm,
E-i-e-i-o!

Synthetic voice: Piper ("lessac" voice). Traditional nursery rhyme (public domain), original animation and music.
